providers.title: Chain lemma
providers.scope: In a connected space covered by open sets, any two points are joined by a finite chain of members with consecutive members meeting.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Connected open sets are path connected
providers.scope: In a locally connected complete metric space every connected open set is path connected.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Peano continua
providers.scope: A locally connected continuum and its connected open subsets are path connected; components of open subsets are open.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Erasing loops
providers.scope: A path between two distinct points can be replaced, inside its image, by a path whose fibres are intervals.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Paths with interval fibres
providers.scope: The image of a path with interval fibres and distinct ends is an arc between its ends.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Arc theorem
providers.scope: The image of a path between two distinct points of a metric space contains an arc between them.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Arcs in connected open sets
providers.scope: Two distinct points of a connected open subset of a locally connected complete metric space are the endpoints of an arc inside it.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Two arcs
providers.scope: The union of two different arcs with the same endpoints contains a simple closed curve.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: First Čech cohomology
providers.scope: The group of classes of nerve cocycles on finite open covers of a compact metric space, with any abelian coefficient group.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Vanishing criterion
providers.scope: The first Čech cohomology vanishes exactly when every locally constant cocycle on every finite open cover is a system of differences of locally constant functions.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Two open sets
providers.scope: With vanishing first Čech cohomology, a locally constant function on the intersection of two open sets covering the space is a difference of locally constant functions on the two sets.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The circle
providers.scope: A simple closed curve has nonzero first Čech cohomology for every nonzero coefficient group.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Retracts
providers.scope: Vanishing of the first Čech cohomology passes to retracts.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Extension across a point
providers.scope: With vanishing first Čech cohomology, a locally constant function near a point whose complement is connected extends across the point.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Classes on closed subsets
providers.scope: In a compact metric space of covering dimension at most one, every first Čech class on a closed subset is the restriction of a class on the space.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No simple closed curves
providers.scope: A compact metric space of dimension at most one with vanishing first Čech cohomology for a nonzero coefficient group contains no simple closed curve.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Arcs in a dendrite
providers.scope: Two points of a dendrite are joined by exactly one arc, and the points strictly inside it are exactly the points separating them.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Cut points
providers.scope: A Peano continuum with more than one point, of dimension at most one and with vanishing first Čech cohomology, has a cut point.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
